# bookmatch — data and integrations for the Goodreads taste-profile recommender

> [!warning] **Documentation:** `docs/` carries the generated six-doc set (scope, architecture, workflows, data, quality, internals) — read it before reading code. Do not edit; it regenerates nightly.

## Data owned

| name | kind | database/location | purpose | migration filename |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `books` | table | SQLite index directory | stores book metadata for the neighbor-gap index | `build_index.py` |
| `lookup` | table | SQLite index directory | maps normalized keys to book IDs for lookup | `build_index.py` |
| `user_item.npz` | file | index directory | sparse user-item rating matrix for collaborative filtering | `build_index.py` |
| `meta.json` | file | index directory | metadata about the built index | `build_index.py` |

## Data read

| name | kind | database/location | purpose | migration filename |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `interactions.csv` | file | raw data directory | rated interactions (rating 1..5) as collaborative filtering signal | `download_dataset.sh` |
| `book_id_map.csv` | file | raw data directory | remapped book_id to real book_id mapping | `download_dataset.sh` |
| `books.json.gz` | file | raw data directory | book metadata streamed into SQLite | `download_dataset.sh` |
| `goodreads_book_authors.json.gz` | file | raw data directory | author ID to name mappings | `download_dataset.sh` |

## Access

The app calls `storage.ensure_schema_ready()` to verify the `books.*` schema exists. Secrets come from a sops drop-in (`bookmatch.service.d/sops.conf` → `/run/bookmatch/secrets.env`, ADR-0021); there is no plaintext `.env`. UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).

## Env keys

- `BOOKMATCH_RAW` — raw data directory for the UCSD Goodreads corpus, defaulting to `~/data/goodreads-ucsd/raw`.
- `BOOKMATCH_INDEX` — index output directory, defaulting to `~/data/goodreads-ucsd/index`.
- `BASE` — UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
- `BRANCH` — UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
- `DEST` — UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
- `FILES` — UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
- `LAST_GOOD_FILE` — UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
- `PREV` — UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
- `TARGET` — UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).

## External integrations

| external system | exchange | direction | transport |
|---|---|---|---|
| UCSD Goodreads corpus (Wan & McAuley 2018) | downloads `interactions`, `book_id_map`, `books`, and `authors` files | inbound | direct HTTP with resume (`curl -C -`), retries, 2-hour timeout per file |

## Consumers

- `deploy.sh` — reads `/api/health` and requires it to report `ok` AND `corpus_ready` before considering a deploy healthy.
- `scripts/build_index.py` — reads the raw corpus files and writes the index directory.
- `scripts/download_dataset.sh` — writes the raw corpus files to `BOOKMATCH_RAW`.
